notes: Major Studio workspace redesign. Skin documents now sit in compact tabs beneath a cleaner app header; the old second row of Editor/Starters/Randomizer/Color/Gradient tabs is replaced by real tool buttons. The editor uses a numbered left navigator with Background, Header, Title, Author, combined Tags & Metadata, Summary, Notes, Main Text, Chapter Titles, Interface/UI, Footer, and Skin-Wide sections. The live AO3 preview becomes the main canvas with a unified device/page toolbar, Fit to Screen, Refresh, and a Page Navigator. Existing controls, skin-tab persistence, AO3 preview structure, gradients, starters, randomizer, Color Studio, Gradient Library, import/export, and 0.1.61 AO3/updater fixes remain in place.
